subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should OpenClaw change Xiaomi pay-as-you-go and Token Plan fresh onboarding defaults to `mimo-v2.5`, or should this PR be narrowed to catalog-only V2.5 availability?
rationale: The code is in the right plugin/docs boundary, but changing provider defaults is an upgrade-sensitive product choice that automation cannot approve solely from proof and upstream model availability.

options.title: Sponsor V2.5 defaults
options.body: Accept the PR's default flip for fresh/no-primary Xiaomi setup and own the user-visible onboarding/model-choice change.

options.title: Request catalog-only rows
options.body: Keep the V2.5 pay-as-you-go catalog/docs additions but leave existing Xiaomi defaults unchanged until a separate default decision lands.

options.title: Pause behind #87277
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked behind the broader Xiaomi V2.5 and multimodal-routing issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor V2.5 defaults
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's default flip for fresh/no-primary Xiaomi setup and own the user-visible onboarding/model-choice change.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Xiaomi Token Plan/V2.5 onboarding and catalog work closest to the default choice changed here.
